title: Cross-model zero-shot FP8 calibration and chaos validation suite for Hopper
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a deterministic, reusable validation harness that runs FP8 calibration profiles across a broad set of model families (decoder-only, encoder-decoder, LLM-chat) with synthetic perturbations (token dropout/noise, attention scaling, prefix shuffling) and zero-shot metric comparisons. The suite's purpose is to expose brittle activation states and dataset-agnostic failure modes for E4M3/E5M2 selections on Hopper, and to produce actionable gating signals for canary and rollout automation.
background: Recent hopper FP8 enablement work has focused on per-model calibration and staged canaries. However, we observe occasional regressions that only appear under distribution shifts or rare token sequences. Current calibration pipelines cover golden evals and shadow traces but lack a reproducible, cross-model chaos validation pass that stresses activation quantization boundaries. This ticket complements the calibration pipeline by adding deterministic synthetic perturbations and statistical tests to detect fragile activations before public rollout.
goals: Create a self-contained validation harness that can be run in CI or on-demand against a model catalog subset (50 small/medium/large variants).

Implement 6 synthetic perturbation modes that emulate common production shifts (token drop, token noise, long-prefix padding, attention-scale multiplier, kv-cache truncation, extreme length rollouts).
Define and compute zero-shot metrics that correlate with human-facing quality (perplexity drift, n-gram edit distance on generated probes, logit distribution KL to fp32 reference).
Output a compact pass/fail signal and a graded fragility score per model/profile/perturbation used by canary gating logic.
success_metrics: Detects at least 90% of historical regressions from the past 6 months when replayed through the harness (measured against incident list).
Produces low-noise fragility scores (95% of runs have stddev < 3% on repeated runs).
Integration with canary gate reduces post-rollout anomalies attributed to FP8 by >= 50% during the first month after rollout.
acceptance_criteria: Harness runs end-to-end in CI and completes for the baseline model set within the time budget (wall time < 2 hours on a single Hopper shard).
Outputs include: fragility CSV, per-perturbation diffs, threshold recommendations, and a structured report uploaded to the artifacts S3 path.
Automated tests that validate the harness determinism (seeded runs produce identical fragility scores within tolerance).
A documented mapping from fragility score to rollout action (allow, canary, block) has been reviewed and signed off by PM and Reliability.
implementation_plan: Design harness API and config schema for model + profile + perturbation sets (owner: Alejandro).
Implement synthetic perturbation library in Python with NumPy/Torch utilities and unit tests (owner: Lila Park).
Integrate FP8 calibration runner to load quantized profile and produce logits with reference fp32 path for comparison (owner: runtime team - Samir Patel).
Add statistical comparison module: KL on logit distributions, perplexity drift, token-level edit distance probes (owner: Applied ML - Jonah).
Create CI job and k8s job template to run harness on dedicated Hopper shard with resource budgeting and timeout (owner: infra - Priya Nair).
Wire output artifacts to the calibration dashboard and add a fragility dashboard panel with historical baseline (owner: observability - Chen Wei).
telemetry_and_alerting: Emit fragility_score metric per model/profile/perturbation to telemetry.bucket.quant_fragility.
Add an alert rule: if new fragility_score exceeds baseline + 4 sigma for a candidate profile during canary, set canary status to 'blocked'.
Log detailed diffs to centralized S3 with links back to run_id for forensic debugging.
rollout_plan: Run harness against the current canary cohort in shadow mode for 2 days; collect fragility scores and compare to baseline.
If no blocked signals, enable model-profile in limited canary (1% traffic) for 24h with enhanced tracing.
After 72h with no critical alerts and fragility within threshold, promote to staged rollout with autoscale off for safety.
qa_and_validation: Unit tests for each perturbation mode and statistical comparison functions.
Re-run the harness on a replay of 12 documented historical regressions and produce a validation report showing detection or explain why it was missed.
Manual review of three representative failure traces to confirm human-interpretable root causes.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: False positives from synthetic perturbations cause unnecessary blocks. Mitigation: calibrate thresholds using historical baseline and expose a 'lenient' mode for initial runs.
Risk: Long run time increases CI queue pressure. Mitigation: sub-sample models, run heavy regressions on a periodic nightly job instead of every PR.
Risk: Misalignment between fragility score and user-visible quality. Mitigation: include human-reviewed probes and correlate with production error reports before automating strict blocks.
